# Autarki

> The buyer pays you, and you keep the keys. Autarki is the wallet and the shop.

Autarki is in beta. It runs on your computer. A 64-bit Android phone can install its own copy. A phone on the same network can still open your computer's page. This website stores nothing and does not take an order. Pay with XBT or Pay with BTC. XBT is named first.

## Pages

- [Home](https://autarki.app/index.md): No platform. Just the sale. The buyer pays you, and you keep the keys. You hold the 24 words. The stall is public and the order is a private note. Pay with XBT still spends XBT. Pay with BTC still spends BTC. When you pay the other coin, the node that carries the payment charges 1.5%. Autarki does not collect that fee. It does not apply when you pay the coin asked for. When the seller holds a float, a shipped classified stays on the seller's node until Mark received. Autarki cannot move those coins. Without that float, the shipment is not held.
- [Notice board](https://autarki.app/notice-board.md): A wallet publishes the stall. This page reads the relay, stores nothing, and does not take an order. A description that starts with Available only on Autarki; is left off.
- [Wallet](https://autarki.app/wallet.md): You hold the 24 words. Lightning for XBT and for BTC comes with your wallet. You can also use Lightning on another Autarki that you keep running. Watch only keeps the account public key and cannot sign. Restore this Lightning backup brings coins still in that Lightning node's wallet back after the scan. Open channels do not return. Paying the other coin spends the coin you already hold. The node that carries the payment charges 1.5%, plus the normal network fees. Autarki does not collect that fee. It does not apply when you pay the coin asked for. The wallet connects to nodes other people operate. Those nodes charge the routing fee and the room fee. One XBT sat is not one BTC sat. If that direction cannot pay, the other coin stays off the screen. Balance is the confirmed coins still held on-chain. Lightning is not added to Balance.
- [Shop](https://autarki.app/shop.md): The shop runs on your computer. The stall is public. The order is private. Autarki does not take a cut of the catalog price. One product can keep a US dollar or Canadian dollar price. The dollar price stays and the coin amount is set when you pay. A routing fee and a room fee are charged by nodes other people operate. Autarki does not collect them. A shop sale does not name a referee. A store stall does not name one.
- [Classifieds](https://autarki.app/classifieds.md): Ship pays with Lightning. When the seller holds a float, the coins sit on the seller's node until Mark received. Autarki cannot move them. Without that float, the shipment is not held. The named referee decides, does not hold the coins, and cannot spend them. This page can publish a note a Nostr extension signs. The form has the same place, image, and map fields as the app. Category comes first. Offer and Hire appear only for a job. A hire carries no payment code. One ad can keep a price in US dollars or Canadian dollars. The dollar price stays and the coin amount is set when you pay. Goods, a service, or a rental with a price above zero names the shipment. A giveaway can name images. A personal does not. Preview this ad shows the note on this page and does not publish it. Show this ad on other markets posts a second note with no price. The sale stays on the relay this board reads. The board terms are accepted before the first note.
- [Find a referee](https://autarki.app/referee.md): A referee is named on a classified shipment. Both sides name the same person before payment, or both name nobody. The names are shown. The field narrows them. Copy a public name from this page. The field is a Discord name, a nostr public key (npub), or a nostr nickname. A nostr name can be listed with no Discord name. The card shows the nostr nickname, and the small Discord name when they linked one. A space in the typed Discord name is ignored. Linking a Discord name does not by itself list a person. The ask is Settings, then Nostr, then Profile, then List me on Find a referee. The referee does not hold the coins and cannot spend them. Autarki cannot move them. Autarki does not check the Discord message. A shop sale does not name a referee. A store stall does not name one.
- [Mining](https://autarki.app/mining.md): Paste a RouteHash token, then press Mine XBT or Mine BTC. The next reward address is your wallet's. Mine itself does not spend. RouteHash is a separate site. Autarki connects to it and does not collect the hire. Mine needs AMD or Intel.
- [Install](https://autarki.app/install.md): Lightning for XBT and for BTC is in the AMD and Intel StartOS package, the Ubuntu image, the Umbrel amd64 image file, and Android 0.1.0 (76). The Umbrel community store listing 0.1.34, a Raspberry Pi, and Umbrel arm64 leave Lightning off. iPhone 0.1.0 build 20 is the same page and does not start Lightning. The public TestFlight test is https://testflight.apple.com/join/2WMBzSpM.
- [Guide](https://autarki.app/guide.md): The 29 procedures for the shop, classifieds, the wallet, and mining. A step marked Spend is the click that moves coins. Prepare payment fills Send and does not spend. A Lightning payment request is not a payment.
- [Privacy](https://autarki.app/privacy.md): The 24 words stay on your device. The camera scans a code. Location fills the shop. The page talks to relays and nodes. Do not use this where the law where you are forbids it, including a place under sanction. Autarki does not check where you are. Save a copy before you wipe the app. It can hold the shop book and the other books on this computer. An open Lightning channel is not in that file. The 24 words do not bring the shop book back. The wallet's classifieds list starts at wss://165.245.235.36:51911. This site still reads and publishes classifieds at wss://nostr.autarki.app.
- [Board rules](https://autarki.app/board.md): Rules for a public shop note and a classified. Child sexual content is forbidden. A report does not remove the ad. Do not post where the law where you are forbids it, including a place under sanction. Autarki does not check where you are.
- [Support](https://autarki.app/support.md): Help with Autarki is in Discord #autarki. This site does not sign in and cannot recover the 24 words.
- [Another node](https://autarki.app/channel.md): Incoming room for a Lightning node that is not the Autarki page in front of you. Blake2b XBT, then SHA-256 BTC. The price is sats. The node charges it. Autarki does not collect it. This page does not take the fee. A bare fee does not name the node.

## Optional

- [Download 0.1.0](https://github.com/RouteHash-com/autarki/releases/tag/0.1.0): The public download. Check SHA256SUMS from that same release.
- [Android 0.1.0](https://github.com/RouteHash-com/autarki/releases/download/0.1.0/autarki-android.apk): Version 0.1.0 (76). Lightning for XBT and for BTC comes with this package. Google Play offers open testing at https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.autarki and at https://play.google.com/apps/testing/app.autarki. Download the file for a 64-bit Android phone. Allow the phone to install it. This file installs over the previous signed 0.1.0 package. A phone that already has 0.1.0 (1) has to uninstall that copy first. Request access at https://appdistribution.firebase.dev/i/2ae8a6c81ce866a4.
- [iPhone 0.1.0](https://testflight.apple.com/join/2WMBzSpM): Version 0.1.0, build 20. The same page as the computer and Android packages. This build does not start Lightning. It is not an App Store listing. Join the public TestFlight test.
- [Source](https://github.com/RouteHash-com/autarki): The Autarki repository.
- [Umbrel community store](https://github.com/RouteHash-com/umbrel-store): The RouteHash community store. It is not the official Umbrel App Store.
- [Discord #autarki](https://discord.gg/VBxvzQXvt): Bug reports.
- [routehash.com](https://routehash.com): The mining site. The hire happens in the wallet. RouteHash is a separate site. Autarki connects to it and does not collect the hire.
